latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the conversation-format-selector skill.
- Helps users choose the best format—casual chat, scheduled meeting, or phone/video call—for customer discovery conversations.
- Guides on format, duration, setting, and approach based on who the user wants to talk to and learning goals.
- Warns against the Meeting Anti-Pattern (defaulting to formal meetings when unnecessary).
- Recommends the right approach whether engaging at events, scheduling talks, or conducting interviews.
- Integrates with conversation-sourcing-planner (for finding people) and conversation-question-designer (for crafting questions).
